findings.evidence: The locator's second quotation, "The numbers reported use Claude Code in --bare mode and xhigh thinking effort for Opus 5.5", does not appear in evidence.system_card.quotes. The supplied verbatim extracts are only (1) "Claude Opus 5.5 scored 66.36% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 with safeguards enabled" and (2) "xhigh thinking effort for Opus 5.5 (which at max effort scores 64.8%, within noise of xhigh)" (line break rendered as space). Extract (2) shares the substring "xhigh thinking effort for Opus 5.5" but is a different sentence. Criterion 5 requires the supporting_sources locators to quote the system card text verbatim; this quotation is unverifiable against the supplied evidence. (The locator's first quotation matches extract (1) verbatim, and the value 66.4 agrees with 66.36% at the printed precision.)
findings.repair: If the sentence exists in the retained system-card capture, add it verbatim to evidence.system_card.quotes so the locator can be verified (evidence-completeness fix). Otherwise replace the second quotation in the locator with attested text, e.g. quote the extract containing "xhigh thinking effort for Opus 5.5". Keep the verified 66.36% quotation unchanged.

findings.evidence: Every row's protocol states: "The system card (section 8.5) states the reported numbers use Claude Code in --bare mode, with production safeguards enabled (a fallback model answered flagged requests)." The supplied system-card extracts attest only "with safeguards enabled", 66.36% at xhigh, and 64.8% at max; they do not mention "--bare mode", "production" safeguards, or any fallback model. The only other packet occurrences of "--bare" and fallback claims are the unverified locator quote (see the xhigh finding above) and the withdrawn row's own protocol, neither of which is a verbatim extract of the retained capture. Criterion 6: "The protocol text must not claim anything the evidence does not show." The data values themselves are unaffected.
findings.repair: Either add the verbatim system-card extract(s) supporting "--bare mode" and the fallback-model statement to evidence.system_card.quotes, or trim the protocol sentence in all five rows to what the extracts show (e.g. "with safeguards enabled") and drop the parenthetical fallback claim.

findings.evidence: The protocol asserts the replaced row was "withdrawn 2026-09-26" and references it as "the CR-123 row". The packet confirms the withdrawal itself (goal text and evidence.withdrawn_row, whose model_id claude-opus-5.5::max conflicts with the caption's xhigh statement, confirming the misconfiguration), but no supplied evidence attests the date 2026-09-26 or the identifier "CR-123".
findings.repair: Add the withdrawal record (ticket id and date) to the evidence packet, or drop the unattested specifics and keep only what the packet supports (e.g. "Replaces self-reported:claude-opus-55-terminal-bench-4-0, which had joined this cell to max effort; withdrawn").

uncertainties: Whether evidence.system_card.quotes is intended to be exhaustive of the relevant section 8.5 text. If it is only a sample, the first two findings are evidence-completeness gaps (fix by adding extracts); if exhaustive, the artifact rows over-quote and over-claim (fix by editing locator/protocol text).

The chart-row locators' navigational details (section "Coding", viewSwitcher view "Agentic terminal coding") are not present in the supplied chart evidence; the substantive CSV line quotes (opus55 low/med/high/max) were verified verbatim against evidence.chart.csv_lines, so this is treated as unverifiable context, not an error.

Criterion 6's phrase "supporting_sources equal evidence.system_card" was read as applying where supporting_sources are present (xhigh and max rows; their url, retrieved_at, sha256 and file all match evidence.system_card). The low/medium/high chart rows carry no supporting_sources; treated as acceptable because the supplied system-card extracts report only xhigh and max efforts, but if the criterion requires the system card on every row, those three rows would need it added.

All other checks passed on the supplied evidence: caption supports xhigh for the printed 66.4 cell and the withdrawn ::max attachment was wrong; chart values 38.5/57.6/64.2/64.8 match the CSV y fields exactly with verbatim line quotes; effort mapping low/med/high/xhigh/max -> low/medium/high/xhigh/max is correct and all model_ids are in evidence.catalog_configurations; exactly one row per effort with no other-series rows; source metadata fields equal evidence.source on all rows; benchmark_id, unit, basis and comparison_key conform; artifact_sha256 is echoed from the packet and was not recomputed (no execution capability).
